use_when: to show an icon at a consistent size and shape
Outlined when the icon should stand out as its own element
Size 12 or 16 in tight spaces, 24 for everyday use, 32 for emphasis

dont_use_when.when: for an action people can press.
to hold text or more than one icon.
Do not stretch it or draw a custom size.

best_practice: Use the swapIcon property to change the icon. Don't detach.
Use the same Type and Shape within one group of icons.
Put one icon in each container.
Pair the icon with a visible label when the meaning isn't obvious.

variant_intent.type=Outlined: Figma: when the icon should stand out as its own element.

a11y.fact: Without a label the icon is hidden from assistive tech (aria-hidden).
With a label the icon is announced as an image named by the label (role="img", aria-label).
